title: Review of the Harbor View Inn · Posted by Daniel K.
L: I stayed at the Harbor View Inn for three nights during a business trip in March.
The location is ideal: the convention center is a five-minute walk away, and there are several good restaurants nearby.
My room was clean and quiet, although the Wi-Fi was slow in the evenings.
The staff were extremely helpful; when I needed to print documents late at night, the night manager let me use the office printer.
The breakfast was simple but fresh.
I would definitely stay here again on my next visit.
